EOS-inclusive bits per raw UTF-8 byte
sources.details: For an unchanged source side, sum all scored next-token natural-log losses including one EOS per document; divide by raw UTF-8 byte count times ln(2). TinyStories validation: 76450.681640625/(42402*ln2)=2.6011749274918783. Poetry: 17325.84912109375/(6671*ln2)=3.7469519721469586. Rounded five decimals give 2.60117 and 3.74695. Token means divide by 42453 and 6707 separately.
